slides.texte_overlay:
Practical skills every young man
should master before 30
Change a tyre and jump-start a car. Ten minutes of learning saves you from waiting hours by the side of the road. Watch one video, then practise once with a friend before you ever need it.
Cook for six people. A big pasta dish, a curry, a roast. Being able to feed a group makes you the friend everyone wants to visit.
Negotiate calmly. Salary, rent, a used car. Asking for a better deal politely can be worth thousands over the years. A basic toolbox is all you need.
Do basic home repairs. Fix a dripping tap, patch a wall, put up shelves. Small repairs save money and make you feel capable.
Keep learning every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it has made me the guy with an answer for everything.
slides.texte_sophia: Keep learning every day. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It has made me the guy with an answer for everything.

slides.texte_overlay: Give a short speech without notes. A toast, a presentation, a team update. Speaking clearly in public opens doors everywhere.
File your own paperwork. Taxes, insurance, contracts. Understanding your admin protects your money and your peace of mind.
